old_failed_experiment: The previous train-only model failed the old internal test AUC gate (.733 < .75). This result is not overwritten.
training: All 2740 previously curated ChEMBL37 compounds; the former internal validation/test rows are now training data, explicitly, for this new phase only.
algorithm: Previously validation-selected random forest, 200 trees, class_weight balanced, seed 42, one CPU thread; app qsar_core.fit_model train-only sigmoid calibration with 3 scaffold folds
selection: One fixed algorithm; no new candidate/seed/threshold search; external set not used for selection/calibration/fitting
label: Exact reported mean IC50 <= 1000 nM is active; no missing-value or censored-value label imputation
y_randomization: Permute training labels once, seed42; 3 outer StratifiedGroupKFold folds; same fitting procedure; AUC <= .60; external test unused on failure

gates.uncertainty: 95% percentile interval from 5000 nonchiral-Murcko group bootstrap replicates must have balanced-accuracy lower bound > .60

report: Single external evaluation, including all failed gates, confusion counts, source groups and uncertainty; no hyperparameter changes after seeing outcomes
scientific_limitations: Small retrospective curated external benchmark; not prospective or population-representative
Assay protocols differ in preincubation and detection even though human COX-2 and arachidonic acid endpoint are matched
Data provenance and chemical identity reviewed; experimental results have not been independently reproduced
Source/class confounding and structural-domain limits must be reported; no claim about APAP rescue or root growth
exclusions: ADHP fluorescence assay 7562_1 excluded to avoid pooling a distinct readout
Phenoxy compounds 5a-f share old training scaffolds
10b excluded: named/drawn structure and published formula/mass disagree
10e and 10f excluded: Table 1 and discussion exchange numeric values
Unspecified hydrazone E/Z stereochemistry not invented
